waiting_period_days.meaning: Waiting period applied to the increase.

effective_date.meaning: Date the increase attaches (request date plus waiting period).

premium_direction.meaning: Whether the prorated premium is billed or is below the minimum.

prorated_premium.meaning: Premium prorated from the attach date to the expiration date.

flood_claim_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the flood claim entry.

event_type.meaning: Claim event family, verbatim from the flood charter.

claim_number.meaning: Claim number assigned at first notice, e.g. FGC-26-000912.

loss_date.meaning: Date the flood entered the building.

coverage_part.meaning: Coverage part of the entry; none on report, proof and close entries.

location_class.meaning: Whether the damaged property was above grade or in a basement.

payment_type.meaning: Kind of payment; none on non-payment entries.

replacement_cost_amount.meaning: Replacement-cost value after caps; 0.00 when not applicable.

proof_of_loss_amount.meaning: Amount claimed on a signed proof of loss; 0.00 on other entries.

amount.meaning: Amount paid or voided, always positive.

payee.meaning: Party paid; none on non-payment entries.

denial_reason.meaning: Controlled reason on a denial entry; none otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: Payment a void refers to; empty otherwise.

flood_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the policyholder request record.

flood_policy_id.meaning: Policy the request concerns (foreign key -> flood_policies).

request_type.meaning: Kind of request needing the named insured's signature.

cancellation_reason.meaning: Reason the named insured gives for cancelling; other is not an accepted reason.

requested_effective_date.meaning: Date of the reason, on which the named insured asks the cancellation to take effect.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: Moment the request was recorded (the date it is received).

valuables_floater_id.meaning: Primary id of the valuables floater record.

variant_name.meaning: Floater tier held, as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state (basis: lifecycle.states of the valuables charter).

status_reason.meaning: Ground behind an ended status; none otherwise.

blanket_limit.meaning: Blanket unscheduled jewelry limit; 0.00 when none.

storage_credit.meaning: Storage credit claimed for jewelry and watches.

billing_plan.meaning: Billing plan of the current term.

scheduled_total.meaning: Total scheduled value of items on the floater; running sum of the scheduled_value account.

term_premium.meaning: Annual premium rated at binding or renewal.

premium_balance.meaning: Amount owed; positive owed, negative credit; running sum of the premium_balance account.

closed_date.meaning: Date coverage ended; empty while open.

valuables_item_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the schedule entry.

valuables_floater_id.meaning: Floater the item is scheduled on (foreign key -> valuables_floaters).

event_type.meaning: Schedule event family, verbatim from the valuables charter.

item_description.meaning: Item description exactly as on the appraisal or bill of sale.

item_class.meaning: Class of the item, which sets its rate.

appraisal_date.meaning: Date of the appraisal or bill of sale; empty for a removal.

acquired_date.meaning: Date the insured acquired the item; empty when not stated.

amount.meaning: Scheduled value added, the increase on revaluation, or the value removed, always positive.

removal_reason.meaning: Why the item left the schedule; none on other entries.

source_entry_id.meaning: Scheduling entry a revaluation or removal refers to; empty otherwise.

valuables_billing_id.meaning: Primary id of the premium ledger entry.

valuables_floater_id.meaning: Floater of the entry (foreign key -> valuables_floaters).

event_type.meaning: Ledger event family, verbatim from the valuables charter.

term_effective_date.meaning: Term of the entry; empty where not applicable.

installment_number.meaning: Installment position (1 = first); 0 when not tied to an installment.

due_date.meaning: Due date of a billed installment; empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a payment or refund; none otherwise.

payment_reference.meaning: Confirmation or check number exactly as issued; empty otherwise.

change_reason.meaning: What produced an additional or return premium entry; none otherwise.

effective_date.meaning: Date an item change or cancellation applies; empty otherwise.

source_item_id.meaning: Schedule entry an additional or return premium belongs to; empty otherwise.

valuables_claim_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim entry.

event_type.meaning: Claim event family, verbatim from the valuables charter.

item_entry_id.meaning: Schedule entry of the item paid or denied; empty for a blanket item.

payment_type.meaning: Kind of payment; none on non-payment entries.

amount.meaning: Amount paid or voided, always positive.

denial_reason.meaning: Controlled reason on a denial entry; none otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: Payment a void refers to; empty otherwise.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the verification record (content hash of the customer id).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; once true it never returns to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the human-handoff record.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
